title: Route an event to people and channels
description:
**Reworked 2026-11-04:** Ryan reversed the architecture. No new AWS account and no central service; see docs/notifications-plan.md in AnthusAI/Caducus.

**Milestone:** M1, first slice

**Goal.** As the package, I turn one accepted event into one queued delivery per person and channel. First host: the operator piece, with operators from its SSM parameter.

**Build.**
- `routing.py`, `handlers/router.py`; queue names come from the host's environment. Host's SQS uses maximum concurrency rather than reserved concurrency only if needed.
- Conditional put on `EVENT#<eventId>` / `META` for dedupe. `channels/base.py` defines `Channel.send(delivery) -> Outcome`.
- Open from PR #5: if the router dies after the dedupe write and before queuing, a redelivery is dropped. Mark events as routed.

**Acceptance.**
Unit and behave tests; a redelivered SQS message makes no second delivery.

**Depends on:** kanbus-6eb0c5, kanbus-53a88d

**Specification.**
```gherkin
Feature: Routing
  Scenario: An operator event reaches each operator once
    Given two operators are configured
    When an operator event arrives twice
    Then each operator has exactly one queued email delivery

  Scenario: A kind with no audience is visible
    Given no operators are configured
    When an operator event arrives
    Then the delivery log records "refused" with the reason "no audience"
```
